question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**To cry stinking fish**

options.text: Undervaluing one's own worth or effort

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To cry stinking fish"** refers to undervaluing one's own worth or effort. It means presenting oneself negatively or undermining one's own abilities. (अपने स्वयं के मूल्य या प्रयास को कम आंकना)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his hard work, he always cries stinking fish and says his efforts are not good enough.
 
 
• This phrase is often used to describe people who fail to recognize their own talents or achievements and focus instead on their perceived flaws or shortcomings. (अपने स्वयं के दोषों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना और अपने कौशल को कम आंकना)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Boasting excessively** (अत्यधिक घमंड करना): To brag or show off excessively about one's achievements or qualities. 
 
 
• **Example:** He was boasting excessively about his promotion at the office party.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: Ridiculing others** (दूसरों का मजाक उड़ाना): To mock or make fun of someone in a hurtful way.
 
 
• **Example:** Ridiculing others for their mistakes is not a good quality.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Taking pride silently** (चुपचाप गर्व महसूस करना): To feel proud without expressing it openly.
 
 
• **Example:** She silently took pride in her son's achievements.
 
 

38:T5b7,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
